claim: The frame renderer (xmapedit-observe) draws a tile the game shows as a voxel model (e.g. chair 758) as its flat sprite, so a frame shows neither the model's facing nor its true bulk.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-18, correcting a report that the chairs were 'far too big': 'maybe little bigger'.
use: Judge a voxel's size from Blood's own repeats (tools.tile_usage N) and set its angle deliberately; never report a voxel's size or facing from a frame.
